title: Acne (Pimples)
summary: Acne forms when pores clog with oil and dead skin and bacteria cause inflammation. Gentle cleansing, non-comedogenic products and ingredients like salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide help; severe acne needs a dermatologist.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
